components.title: acme-health-grc-baseline
components.description: The GRC baseline this capstone wraps around the inherited Patient Intake API starter (GRCEngClub/cgep-app-starter): customer-managed KMS keys, S3/DynamoDB hardening overrides, least-privilege IAM, and CloudTrail-driven continuous monitoring, closing GAP-01, GAP-02, GAP-03, GAP-04, and GAP-07 from GAPS.md.
components.purpose: Make the inherited patient-intake workload audit-defensible against the HIPAA Security Rule without modifying the workload's own application logic.

control-implementations.description: HIPAA Security Rule technical safeguards implemented by this baseline. NIST publishes no machine-readable OSCAL catalog for HIPAA/SP 800-66 (confirmed against usnistgov/oscal-content, which covers only CSF, SP800-171, SP800-172, SP800-218, and SP800-53) -- control-id values below are slugified 164.x citations prefixed with a letter (OSCAL tokens cannot start with a digit), not references into a resolvable catalog, and the literal citation is repeated in each requirement's hipaa-citation prop per FRAMEWORKS.md's guidance.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-01: the uploads S3 bucket (holding PHI attachments) is encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key instead of AWS-managed SSE-S3, bringing key custody under Acme Health's control. Enforced via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration.uploads (terraform/s3_overrides.tf), using the CMK defined in terraform/kms.tf (aws_kms_key.s3_data).

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle (terraform plan.json + policy-gate-results.json) from the run that applied the reviewed baseline (commit 92adbf8). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34460022480.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-02: the DynamoDB submissions table (holding PHI records) is encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key instead of the AWS-owned default. Enforced via the server_side_encryption block merged into aws_dynamodb_table.intake by terraform/dynamodb_override.tf, using the CMK defined in terraform/kms.tf (aws_kms_key.dynamodb_data).

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle from the run that applied the reviewed baseline (commit 92adbf8). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34460022480.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-03: the uploads bucket denies any S3 request made without TLS, enforcing transmission security for PHI in transit. Enforced via aws_s3_bucket_policy.uploads (terraform/s3_overrides.tf), a Deny statement conditioned on aws:SecureTransport == false.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle from the run that applied the reviewed baseline (commit 92adbf8). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34460022480.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-04: versioning is enabled on the uploads bucket, so an overwritten or deleted PHI attachment remains recoverable -- part of Acme Health's contingency plan for data backup. Enforced via aws_s3_bucket_versioning.uploads (terraform/s3_overrides.tf).

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle from the run that applied the reviewed baseline (commit 92adbf8). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34460022480.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-07: the Lambda handler's inline IAM policy is scoped to the exact three actions the handler code calls (dynamodb:PutItem, s3:PutObject under uploads/*, and the KMS actions needed to write through the CMKs above), replacing the starter's dynamodb:*/s3:* wildcard grant. Enforced via the policy merged into aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_inline by terraform/iam_override.tf.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle from the run that applied the reviewed baseline (commit 92adbf8). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34460022480.
